title: Grateful Dead Live at Cleveland Music Hall on 1981-03-02
lineage: DAT > TASCAM DA-20 (S/PDIF out) -> Apogee Wide Eye S/PDIF interconnect -> LynxTWO-A Audio Reference Interface (S/PDIF in) -> Wavelab 6.0 (Ozone, L2) -> WAV -> FLAC
source: NAK 700 (shotgun capsules) > Nak 550 Cassette Recorder > Maxell Metal > HHB Porta-a-DAT

ai_review.summary: Energetic early‑80s show with strong Shakedown/Althea highlights and a clean, listenable audience recording.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the concert’s high energy – opening with a rocking Shakedown, a solid Althea, multiple fiery Playin’ excerpts and a tender China Doll. The tape is described as an “awesome” and “sparking” AUD that captures the upbeat vibe without major flaws, making it a worthwhile listen for early‑80s fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive comments about both performance and recording quality across two detailed reviews; weighting favors the strong show, yielding a rating just above four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note an awesome sound quality with a clean mix that is very listenable and “sparking”; no major dropouts or muffling mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Up‑tempo, well‑played set with energetic first‑set openers and a second set that highlights a thrice‑appearing Playin' and a tender China Doll, keeping the momentum high throughout.
